name: HD 110082B

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list HD 110082 and HD 110082B in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 5765748511163751936 and 5765748511163760640), 6,239 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 9.3e-4: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to HD 110082, 6,239 AU away.

radius.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the radius of TIC 383400718 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

text.card: HD 110082B is a star of 3,262 K, bound to HD 110082 6,239 AU away.
text.introduction: HD 110082B shares its motion through space with HD 110082, 6,239 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: HD 110082B's orbit around HD 110082 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are

radialVelocity.source: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 5765748511163760640 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 30,000 of its distance per century
